body.x: Global News Network “AVING News”, a media partner of IFA, the world’s largest exhibition, will hold the “CES 2016 Review & F2F Conference” at AVING Studio in Guro Digital Complex on the 28th.

AVING News, the only company that has sent reporters to CES for 11 years, will share the key points of CES 2016 and global industrial trends. This conference will provide a glimpse into the current state of the global IoT and ICT technologies, along with vivid news from participating domestic companies.
The conference consists of the CES 2016 review documentary, participating companies’ speeches, a special business management lecture, and a networking party.

As for the review documentary, it is significantly meaningful, as the entire process -- including the shooting and editing -- was produced by using only an iPhone 6s Plus. After the event, the documentary will be distributed as an educational material to domestic elementary, middle, and high schools and universities.

Lectures and insights will be given by the TALKKING Speech CEO, DROGEN CEO Lee Heung-shin from the drones field, Former’sFARM CEO Yoon Jeong-rok from the 3D printing field, boud CEO Park Seong-ho from the live-action camera field, and Innomdle Lap CEO Yoon Taehyun.
After the official speeches, a networking party will be prepared, where related officials and CEOs will have an opportunity to communicate directly with each other.

AVING News chief director Choe Ji-hun said: “AVING News is the only media organization in the country that has covered the CES for over 10 years. Based on accumulated insights, we will hold the CES 2016 Review & F2F Conference in major cities, including Busan, Daegu, and Gwangju. We are also preparing the review conference for MWC 2016 (Mobile World Congress), the world’s largest mobile exhibition held in February.”

One can register for the event via ONOFFMIX (http://onoffmix.com/event/60787) by Wednesday the 27th. Special pricing is available to those who register during the early registration period and undergraduates who want to participate. AVING News CES Review Office Other (02-856-3276, mice@aving.net) provides more information about the event.

“CES”, which ran for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th in Las Vegas by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), is the world’s largest electronics and IT exhibition. Global News Network AVING News has vividly reported on stories at CES 2016 in Korean as well as in English and Chinese. It has produced the largest number of articles about CES in the country.
